scope: Five development cases, not held-out or full-40 evaluation. Manual relations never enter model input.

cases.question: The Innviertel is a traditional Austrian region southeast of a river that is how many km long?
cases.manual_relation: Innviertel is southeast of the unknown river; preserve km length target.

cases.question: The district of Velora lies northeast of a lake that covers how many square kilometers?
cases.manual_relation: Velora northeast of unknown lake; target lake area in square kilometers.

cases.question: A lake northeast of the district of Velora covers how many square kilometers?
cases.manual_relation: Unknown lake northeast of Velora; target lake area in square kilometers.

cases.question: The town of Merovin is west of a mountain that is how many meters high?
cases.manual_relation: Merovin west of unknown mountain; target mountain height in meters.

cases.question: A mountain west of the town of Merovin is how many meters high?
cases.manual_relation: Unknown mountain west of Merovin; target mountain height in meters.
